frame: Corrected GEO XYZ are in the 67P body frame used by the SHAP7 product; projective camera fitted from their pixel correspondences, checked against held-out pixels and the RMOC shape.

quality.radianceCompanion: Every decoded L4 radiance pixel must equal its L5 counterpart before the quality map is used.
quality.rejected: Missing VALID, bad, saturated, readout, nonlinear, shutter or reserved flags.
quality.interpretation: Bit 0 is positive VALID. The calibration-pipeline bit table and archived values take precedence over ambiguous all-zero wording in the science user guide. LOSSY is retained only for visual use.

photometry.description: Lommel-Seeliger disk normalization, D=2 cos(i)/(cos(i)+cos(e)); calibrated radiance divided by D before interpolation, normalized to D(0,0)=1. No phase, roughness or cast-shadow recovery. Not measured albedo.
photometry.applicationLighting: Uniform flood displays normalized imagery without directional model lights. Shadows applies the existing source-mesh fixed-epoch Sun recipe. Both banks are prepared.

manuals.purpose: Nine GEO planes, coordinates, angles and SHAP7 geometry.
Section 3.15.2: quality bits; Section 3.16: GEO generated from L4 radiance.
PDS plane layout, stored image orientation and image metadata.

limits: Four single-band observations within 9 hours 36 minutes; no color inference, extrapolation or backside fill.
RMOC and SHAP7 are distinct models; all sample correspondences are explicitly bounded.
Residual photographed cast shadows and scattering effects remain after disk normalization.
Positive, zero and negative finite radiance are retained when validity/geometry/photometry permit.

mosaic.selection: Lowest maximum source emission angle among qualified observations; source order breaks exact ties. No brightness-based coverage rejection.
mosaic.levels: One bounded gain per observation, fitted from robust log-ratios of co-located valid surface samples; first observation anchors the display. This is empirical level matching, not a phase correction.
mosaic.display: The first observation owns the common grayscale stretch.
mosaic.sourceIndex: The prepared lossless source-index raster records the winning observation at every atlas texel; zero marks no qualified observation.
